    • Method Detail

      • ifNotExists

        @NonNull
CreateDseKeyspaceStart ifNotExists()
        Adds IF NOT EXISTS to the create keyspace specification. This indicates that the keyspace should not be created it already exists.

      • withReplicationOptions

        @NonNull
CreateDseKeyspace withReplicationOptions​(@NonNull
                                         Map<String,​Object> replicationOptions)
        Adds 'replication' options. One should only use this when they have a custom replication strategy, otherwise it is advisable to use withSimpleStrategy(int) or withNetworkTopologyStrategy(Map).
        Specified by:
        withReplicationOptions in interface KeyspaceReplicationOptions<CreateDseKeyspace>

      • withSimpleStrategy

        @NonNull
default CreateDseKeyspace withSimpleStrategy​(int replicationFactor)
        Adds SimpleStrategy replication options with the given replication factor.

        Note that using this will overwrite any previous use of this method or withNetworkTopologyStrategy(Map).

        Specified by:
        withSimpleStrategy in interface KeyspaceReplicationOptions<CreateDseKeyspace>

      • withNetworkTopologyStrategy

        @NonNull
default CreateDseKeyspace withNetworkTopologyStrategy​(@NonNull
                                                      Map<String,​Integer> replications)
        Adds NetworkTopologyStrategy replication options with the given data center replication factors.

        Note that using this will overwrite any previous use of this method or withSimpleStrategy(int).

        Specified by:
        withNetworkTopologyStrategy in interface KeyspaceReplicationOptions<CreateDseKeyspace>
        Parameters:
